name: Kakum National Park
description: A rainforest destination known for its famous canopy walkway suspended high above the forest floor.

name: Cape Coast Castle
description: A historic coastal castle connected to Ghana's complex history, now a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

name: Elmina Castle
description: A historic castle and important heritage site on Ghana's coast, among the oldest European buildings in sub-Saharan Africa.

name: Mole National Park
description: Ghana's largest wildlife refuge, known for elephants, antelope, and walking safaris.

name: Kwame Nkrumah Memorial Park
description: A memorial site and mausoleum dedicated to Ghana's first president and independence leader.

name: Manhyia Palace Museum
description: A cultural and historical attraction connected to the Asante Kingdom and its royal history.

name: Wli Falls
description: The tallest waterfall in Ghana, reached by a scenic hike through the Agumatsa Wildlife Sanctuary.

name: Aburi Botanical Gardens
description: A peaceful botanical destination in the hills of eastern Ghana, home to towering trees planted over a century ago.

name: Shai Hills Resource Reserve
description: A protected savanna reserve offering wildlife viewing, caves, and rock-climbing just outside Accra.

name: Lake Bosomtwe
description: Ghana's only natural lake, formed inside a meteorite crater over a million years ago.

name: Larabanga Mosque
description: One of the oldest mosques in West Africa, built in a distinctive Sudanese mud-and-reed architectural style.

name: Paga Crocodile Pond
description: A sacred pond where crocodiles are treated as spiritual guardians and live peacefully alongside the local community.

name: Boti Falls
description: A twin waterfall surrounded by forest and unusual rock formations, a popular day trip from Accra.

name: Akosombo Dam
description: The hydroelectric dam that created Lake Volta, one of the largest artificial lakes in the world.

name: National Museum of Ghana
description: Ghana's oldest and largest museum, housing collections on the nation's history, art, and culture.
